tools.name: Portable ReportingPackageValidationAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with six deterministic, read-only operations over synthetic data.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the six-skill package in Draft; explicit approval is required before publication.

tools.name: Microsoft Excel
tools.detail: Working surface for review workbooks in an approved deployment; the package edits no file.

tools.name: Approved ledger and planning extracts
tools.detail: Cited production seams for submissions; no live connection exists in the package.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Uses only the bundled fictional package; never browses or reads live ledgers.

supporting_features.name: Missing is not zero
supporting_features.detail: Unsubmitted cells are blocking; reported zeros are advisory and need confirmation.

supporting_features.name: Deterministic arithmetic
supporting_features.detail: Totals, variances, residuals and counts are computed from the package, never estimated.

supporting_features.name: No external side effects
supporting_features.detail: Never posts journals, edits submissions, releases the package or sends requests.

supporting_features.name: Finance sign-off gate
supporting_features.detail: Commentary stays Draft until blocking exceptions clear and the FP&A manager signs off.
